howto: Press anywhere and drag away from the red stone: a dotted arc shows where it will fly.
Let go to fire. The further you pull, the harder it flies.
Hit 3 bullseyes before your shots run out. Each hit moves the target somewhere new and makes it smaller.
On a keyboard, the arrows aim (Left / Right tilt, Up / Down power) and Space fires.
tips: Pull down and to the left to throw up and to the right.
Watch the WIND arrow: it drifts long shots a little.
A stone that lands short bounces along the grass; it only counts if it goes through the target.
Your best is the fewest shots you have needed to hit all 3.

controls.keyboard: Left / Right tilt the aim, Up / Down change power, Space fires. P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Press and drag back from the stone, then let go. Pause button top right.

difficulty: Easy gives 7 shots for 3 targets, Normal 5, Hard 4.

cheats.effect: The dotted aim arc shows the whole flight

features.one-tap-start: Drag and release on the title card fires your first shot; Space starts with keyboard aiming
features.instant-restart: Tap once on the result card
features.best-score-badge: BEST (fewest shots) under the shot counter
features.tutorial-card: First-run How to play card with an animated pull-and-release; replay from Pause > How to play
features.results: TARGETS DESTROYED! card with shots used and best, or OUT OF SHOTS!
